On April 7th, we celebrate World Health Day.

As many members of the gaming community and modern society suffer from mental health issues, we want to remind you that there's always hope :)

notes.title: There's always hope
notes.content:
[b] The third Monday of January is claimed to be the most depressing day of the year. We call it the Blue Monday. [/b]

The concept of Blue Monday was first introduced in 2005 as a result of a complicated math equastion, which uses many complicated and abstract factors such as weather conditions, debt level, time since Christmas etc. That's why it's generally percieved as a pseudoscience.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30447681/5e95900b5dcfb51f640472b17292e8782f0eaf0e.png[/img]

Nevertheless we wanted to use this occasion to remind you about the severity of mental health issues. Depression is a serious illness and one that shouldn't be ignored. If you have any suspition that you or one of your loved ones is experiencing depression, reach out for proffesional help as soon as possible. Don't ignore even the smallest of symptoms.

Remember – even if you fell like everything around is falling apart, there's always hope. With enough love, care and proffesional help above all. depression can be overcome.

[b] Anxiety and Depression Association of America - https://adaa.org [/b]

[b] National Suicide Prevention Lifeline - 1-800-273-8255 [/b]

notes.title: More positive reviews! Critics say Indygo is "very moving" and "deeply immersive"
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30447681/40878a11c7da9793b63139ba5032273047292b80.png[/img]
Hi All,

The Indygo reviews have been quite positive and it makes us proud. Reviewers have praised the graphical style and the music and have acknowledged the importance of speaking about depression. 

"[i]Don’t miss out on this because it helps to highlight what can happen when you feel you have nowhere left to turn. There’s always help, and this game helps you realize that[/i]," writes [url=http://www.godisageek.com/reviews/indygo-review]Chris White from GodisaGeek[/url]. According to Chris, Indygo is "[i]incredibly effective, making you empathize and relate to the pain [the main character is] suffering[/i]".

"[i]I genuinely feel that Indygo is an accurate - and more importantly – a grounded portrayal of what it’s like to live with the black dog. It never feels preachy or overly dramatic, instead opting to provide a realistic sense of the monotony, loneliness, despair, and meaninglessness that people with depression feel on a day-to-day basis[/i]," writes [url=https://www.gamegrin.com/reviews/indygo-review]Andrew Wowk from GameGrin[/url].

Thanks guys, you’ve really felt what the creators were trying to convey.
Indygo is out now and for the sake of better immersion, it's available in 7 languages.

notes.title: Indygo goes polyglot!
notes.content:
Hey there,

We have another great announcement, especially for those of you, who are neither Polish, nor English and feel more comfortable playing a game which supports their language. 
We think that you already know what we are about to say...

...That’s right! 
[b]Indygo will be available in 7different languages for you to enjoy![/b]

You will be able to play the game in:
- English,
- German,
- French,
- Italian,
- Spanish,
- Russian.
- Polish.

Both the subtitles and the interface will be translated to the language of your choosing.
Moreover, [b]there will also be full audio support for Polish and English.[/b]

notes.title: On the podium of The Big Indie Pitch!
notes.content:
Hi All,

We want to share some great news with you!!!

During [url=http://www.gamearena.pl/en]PGA (Poznań Game Arena)[/url], the biggest game show in Poland held last week, we took part in The Big Indie Pitch at [url=http://www.gamearena.pl/en/news/the_biggest_gamedev_event_in_central_and_eastern_europe]Game Industry Conference.[/url] 

And guess what? 
...
...
...
[h1][b]We made it to 3rd place![/b][/h1] 

We put a lot of heart and effort in our project and we are really grateful that it shows.
Not only did we want to create a game that would be engaging, but we also wanted to shed light on the important issue of depression and it seems we did a pretty good job. 

We hope that you will find Indygo as interesting as the jury found it. 
As always, thank you for your support along our way!

Hugs!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30447681/2fb1518e57fc2bef4fcc4a0d1746d3806283c42d.jpg[/img]
